clue.text: Join with a colleague

definitions.meaning: to join with someone is to ally or link yourself to them, used as a verb
a partner or fellow worker, used as a noun

explanation.surface: An instruction to team up with someone from work.
explanation.definitionFit: The word works as a verb meaning to link up and as a noun for a partner or co-worker.

clue.text: 'Before Christ' for a Roman clergyman, to be exact

parts.note: a Roman would say ante Christum, abbreviated AC, rather than BC
a curate is an assistant member of the clergy

explanation.surface: A pedantic note on how a Roman priest would date things.
explanation.walkthrough: BC is English; the Latin equivalent is ante Christum, AC.
explanation.definitionFit: Exact and precise are synonyms describing something correct in every detail.

clue.text: Cutting point on instrument

parts.note: S is south, a point of the compass
a harp is a stringed musical instrument

explanation.surface: Describing the blade or tip of some tool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'point' is a compass point here, not a sharp tip.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutting remark or edge is keen and biting, a synonym.

clue.text: Colleague attending assembly in the customary manner

indicators.note: attending means accompanying, so the colleague goes alongside, after the assembly

parts.note: a convention is a formal gathering or assembly
an ally is a partner or colleague

explanation.surface: A coworker going to a conference where everything is done the usual way.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something according to custom is doing it by the accepted norms, a synonym phrase.

clue.text: Rising artist isn't a bad craftsman

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the letters for artist are read upwards

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist

indicators.note: bad signals that the letters of isn't and a are spoilt into a new order

explanation.surface: A claim that an up-and-coming painter is a decent maker of things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rising' turns RA (Royal Academician) into AR; 'bad' rearranges ISNT plus A into TISAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A skilled manual worker who makes things by hand is a craftsman, a synonym.

clue.text: Listener let fall a pendant

parts.note: the ear is the organ that listens
to let something fall is to drop it

explanation.surface: Someone eavesdropping drops a piece of jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: A pendant hanging from the earlobe is an earring of a dangling kind, an example.

clue.text: Makes me eager to find ducks

definitions.note: plural, as the bird name is the same in singular and plural

indicators.note: to find means the letters are to be found running across the words of the clue

explanation.surface: Something that gets me keen on spotting waterfowl.
explanation.definitionFit: A dialect name for certain wild ducks such as the wigeon or pintail.

clue.text: Quiet journalist taken in by girl, one with exceptional legs

indicators.note: taken in by means the quiet journalist goes inside the girl's name

parts.note: Millie is a girl's name
P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A girl takes in a quiet reporter, someone with remarkable legs.
explanation.walkthrough: The creature's name suggests a thousand feet, hence 'exceptional legs'.
explanation.definitionFit: A many-legged creature like this has more legs than almost any animal, so it is fair to call them exceptional.

clue.text: This fellow sounds serious

indicators.note: sounds signals that the word for serious is heard, not seen

parts.note: earnest means serious and sincere

explanation.surface: A man whose very name suggests gravity.
explanation.walkthrough: A nod to Wilde's play about the importance of being so named.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's first name, so the clue's fellow is a man bearing it.

clue.text: Investment scheme appears a splendid idea

parts.note: capital is old-fashioned British slang for excellent
a project is a planned idea or undertaking

explanation.surface: A financial plan is praised as an excellent notion.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan for spending money on long-term assets like buildings, an investment scheme.

clue.text: Tea's fashionable in this group

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea
in means fashionable, as in the in thing

explanation.surface: Tea is the trendy drink among this crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: A connected series or a set of linked shops is a chain, a kind of group.

clue.text: Sailor boy in waterproof hat

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor
Paul is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A seaman's son wearing a sou'wester.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link but supplies its own letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Besides the canvas sheet, the word names a sailor's tarred waterproof hat.

clue.text: Put down iron again

definitions.meaning: to put down means to suppress or crush
to iron again is to press a second time

explanation.surface: Doing the laundry a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: Means suppress, and can also be read as press once more, as with clothes.

clue.text: Fruit is found in the monsoon season

indicators.note: found in means is goes inside the word for the wet season

parts.note: the rains is the name for the monsoon season

explanation.surface: Produce that grows during the wet season.
explanation.definitionFit: Dried grapes are a type of fruit, an example.

clue.text: Go to smart spot for romantic rendezvous

parts.note: to have a go is to try
to smart is to sting
a spot is a place

explanation.surface: Advice to visit a chic venue for a date.
explanation.definitionFit: A tryst is a lovers' meeting, so its location is the place for a romantic rendezvous.

clue.text: Recalling many chats with a sailor

indicators.note: recalling read as re-calling, setting the letters of many chats out again in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Remembering lots of conversations with a mariner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recalling' is read as calling again, so MANYCHATS is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sails a yacht is a sailor, a specific kind.

clue.text: Lady's record race, taking place over the mountainside?

parts.note: she is a pronoun for a lady
EP is an extended-play record
a run is a race

explanation.surface: A woman's record time in a fell race.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the loose definition: a hill pasture for flocks.
explanation.definitionFit: An area of hill pasture where flocks graze, often on a mountainside.

clue.text: Talk of shutting up the last address?

parts.note: shutting up a shop is closing it
a speech is a talk

explanation.surface: Wondering about a final speech or one about falling silent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shutting up' suggests silence, but means closing.
explanation.definitionFit: The final speech by counsel in a trial is the last address to the court.

clue.text: Encourage one to breathe in

definitions.meaning: to draw air into the lungs, the medical sense

explanation.surface: Coaching someone to take a breath.
explanation.definitionFit: Means to motivate someone and, literally, to inhale.

clue.text: Note Lister's damaged cartilage

parts.note: G is a musical note

indicators.note: damaged signals the letters of Lister are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A remark that the surgeon Lister has injured cartilage.
explanation.walkthrough: Joseph Lister was the pioneer of antiseptic surgery, fitting the medical surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Tough gristly tissue in meat is cartilage, a synonym.

clue.text: Was evasive, having received hot property

definitions.meaning: to fence is to parry questions evasively
a fence deals in stolen goods, so to fence is to handle them

explanation.surface: A suspect dodging questions about stolen goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Fencing is both verbal sparring and receiving stolen goods.

clue.text: Catches parents out

indicators.note: out indicates the letters of parents are put out of order

explanation.surface: A child catching their parents out.
explanation.definitionFit: To trap someone is to catch them, a synonym.

clue.text: Keep away when one's love has departed

parts.note: I is one, so one's is I plus S
love is zero in tennis, O
late means dead, departed

explanation.surface: Withdrawing from others after a lover has gone.
explanation.definitionFit: To set apart or quarantine is to keep away, a synonym.

clue.text: Large vessel used up in "The Mouse That Roared"

indicators.note: up means read upwards in this down clue
in means the letters are inside the film title's words

explanation.surface: A big ship appears in the old satirical film comedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessel' suggests a ship but means a blood vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: The main artery of the body is the largest blood vessel.

clue.text: Grief expressed at condition

definitions.meaning: an expression of grievance or dissatisfaction
an ailment or illness, as in a medical condition

explanation.surface: Mourning voiced about some state of affairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Means both a grievance voiced and an illness.

clue.text: Something wrong when the Queen has nothing in the car

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina

indicators.note: in means nothing goes inside the car's letters

parts.note: RR is a Rolls-Royce
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A slip when the monarch's car is empty.
explanation.definitionFit: A mistake is something wrong, a synonym.

clue.text: Finished at 500 to 1

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral 500
one is 1

explanation.surface: Done at long odds.
explanation.definitionFit: Completed means finished.

clue.text: Looks at tutor, which causes physical discomfort

parts.note: to eye is to look at
to tutor is to train

explanation.surface: Gazing at a tutor gives a headache.
explanation.definitionFit: Tired, aching eyes from overuse are a form of physical discomfort.
